blocks.text: American inspired with a modern twist, this crossbody bag works equally well for travel and everyday use. It features a roomy compartment with zippered RFID blocking pocket. Features an easy access, locking front zippered pocket and rear zip pocket. Anti-Theft features including slash-resistant construction, locking compartments, slash-resistant and locking straps will keep you and your belongings protected. Strap adjusts for customized comfort. Crafted in a durable cotton canvas with rich suede trim, matte nickel hardware and classic pinstriped lining. The Travelon Anti-Theft Heritage crossbody will quickly become your favorite companion bag.

items: SAFTY AND SECURITY ARE IN THE BAG with 5-Point Anti-Theft features like hidden slash resistant stainless steel mesh body panels, locking zippers, adjustable stainless steel cable strap that can be attached to a stationary object to prevent a grab-n-go
IT ONLY GET'S BETTER WITH AGE, beautifully crafted designed in cotton & canvas material with suede trim, accented in nickel plated hardware
LIGHWEIGHT & PRACTICAL with plenty of storage to keep your items organized. You can wear it over your shoulder or crossbody for hands-free convenience
EXCELLENT SIZE FOR ANY OCCASION featuring front zip and rear slash pockets, 2 open top wall pockets and a tethered key clip and a zippered RFID protected wall pocket
